import os
import requests

from tests.test_config import test_config


def _base_url():
    value = (test_config.TEST_BASE_URL or '').rstrip('/')
    assert value, 'RUNTIME_E2E_CONFIG_MISSING: TEST_BASE_URL/REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL'
    return value


def _credentials():
    email = test_config.TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL
    password = test_config.TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD
    assert email and password, 'RUNTIME_E2E_CONFIG_MISSING: TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL/TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD'
    return {'email': email, 'password': password}


def _login_session():
    session = requests.Session()
    response = session.post(
        f'{_base_url()}/api/auth/login',
        json=_credentials(),
        timeout=20,
    )
    assert response.status_code == 200, f'RUNTIME_LOGIN_FAILED: status={response.status_code}'
    payload = response.json()
    token = payload.get('token')
    assert token, 'RUNTIME_LOGIN_FAILED: token_missing'
    session.headers.update({'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}'})
    return session


def test_runtime_backend_is_reachable_and_centro_ping_is_public():
    response = requests.get(f'{_base_url()}/api/centro-control/ping', timeout=20)
    assert response.status_code == 200, f'CENTRO_PING_FAILED: status={response.status_code}'
    payload = response.json()
    assert payload.get('status') == 'ok'


def test_runtime_rbac_rejects_unauthenticated_requests_for_both_modules():
    centro = requests.get(f'{_base_url()}/api/centro-control/estado', timeout=20)
    sync = requests.get(f'{_base_url()}/api/admin/sync-monitor', timeout=20)
    assert centro.status_code in (401, 403), f'CENTRO_UNAUTH_EXPECTED_401_403: status={centro.status_code}'
    assert sync.status_code in (401, 403), f'SYNC_UNAUTH_EXPECTED_401_403: status={sync.status_code}'


def test_runtime_authenticated_session_can_load_centro_control():
    session = _login_session()
    response = session.get(f'{_base_url()}/api/centro-control/estado', timeout=30)
    assert response.status_code == 200, f'CENTRO_RBAC_OR_RUNTIME_FAILED: status={response.status_code}'
    payload = response.json()
    assert isinstance(payload, dict)


def test_runtime_authenticated_session_can_load_sync_monitor():
    session = _login_session()
    response = session.get(f'{_base_url()}/api/admin/sync-monitor', timeout=30)
    assert response.status_code == 200, f'SYNC_RBAC_OR_RUNTIME_FAILED: status={response.status_code}'
    payload = response.json()
    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    assert 'procesos' in payload
    assert 'kpis' in payload


def test_runtime_centro_control_core_endpoints_load_with_same_session():
    session = _login_session()
    paths = [
        '/api/centro-control/salud/resumen',
        '/api/centro-control/alertas',
        '/api/centro-control/fuentes',
        '/api/centro-control/jobs',
        '/api/centro-control/bitacora',
        '/api/centro-control/metricas',
        '/api/centro-control/historial',
        '/api/centro-control/matriz-resolucion',
        '/api/centro-control/blindaje/modulos',
    ]
    for path in paths:
        response = session.get(f'{_base_url()}{path}', timeout=30)
        assert response.status_code == 200, f'CENTRO_ENDPOINT_FAILED: path={path} status={response.status_code}'


def test_runtime_external_notification_configuration_is_truthful_without_assuming_credentials():
    session = _login_session()
    email_response = session.get(f'{_base_url()}/api/centro-control/email/config', timeout=20)
    whatsapp_response = session.get(f'{_base_url()}/api/centro-control/whatsapp/config', timeout=20)
    all_response = session.get(f'{_base_url()}/api/centro-control/notificaciones/config', timeout=20)
    for name, response in [('email', email_response), ('whatsapp', whatsapp_response), ('all', all_response)]:
        assert response.status_code == 200, f'NOTIFICATION_CONFIG_FAILED: service={name} status={response.status_code}'
    email_payload = email_response.json()
    whatsapp_payload = whatsapp_response.json()
    all_payload = all_response.json()
    assert isinstance(email_payload.get('config'), dict)
    assert isinstance(whatsapp_payload.get('config'), dict)
    assert isinstance(all_payload.get('servicios'), dict)
    email_cfg = email_payload['config']
    whatsapp_cfg = whatsapp_payload['config']
    for field in ('configured', 'enabled'):
        assert field in email_cfg
        assert isinstance(email_cfg[field], bool)
    for field in ('configured', 'enabled', 'twilio_configured'):
        assert field in whatsapp_cfg
        assert isinstance(whatsapp_cfg[field], bool)
    servicios = all_payload['servicios']
    assert {'email', 'whatsapp', 'websocket'}.issubset(servicios.keys())


def test_runtime_e2e_never_sends_external_test_messages():
    source = __file__
    text = open(source, encoding='utf-8').read()
    assert '/email/test' not in text
    assert '/whatsapp/test' not in text
    assert '/alerta-critica' not in text
